title: Endo H/ PNGase F Assay for JESS Automated Western Blot
author: Charis Ma

steps.title: Prepare protein denaturation mix
steps.instruction: In an Eppendorf tube, combine 40 µg protein, 2 µL 10X Glycoprotein Denaturing Buffer, and water to a final volume of 20 µL. Mix well.

steps.title: Denature glycoprotein
steps.instruction: Heat the tube at 100 °C for 10 minutes (00:10:00) to denature the glycoprotein.

steps.title: Split reaction into two tubes
steps.instruction: Divide the 20 µL denatured mixture into two Eppendorf tubes, 10 µL each. Designate one for the Endo H reaction and the other for the PNGase F reaction.

steps.title: Set up Endo H reaction
steps.instruction: Add reagents to the Endo H tube, mix gently, and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL 10X GlycoBuffer 3, 2 µL Endo H, and 6 µL water (final volume 20 µL).

steps.title: Set up PNGase F reaction
steps.instruction: Add reagents to the PNGase F tube, mix gently, and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL 10X GlycoBuffer 2, 2 µL NP‑40, 6 µL water, and 1 µL PNGase F (final volume 21 µL).

steps.title: Add sample buffer to reactions
steps.instruction: Add 480 µL of 0.1X Sample Buffer (Bio‑Techne) to the Endo H tube and 479 µL to the PNGase F tube, bringing each to a total volume of 500 µL.

steps.title: Concentrate reactions with filter
steps.instruction: Transfer each 500 µL reaction to a 10 kDa Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter and spin.

substeps.instruction: Load the entire 500 µL from each tube onto a 10K Amicon Ultra filter.
Spin at 14,000 × g for 20 minutes (00:20:00) at room temperature.

steps.title: Add fluorescent master mix
steps.instruction: Combine the concentrated sample with fluorescent detection reagents.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 parts of the washed Endo H/PNGase F sample to 1 part 5X Fluorescent Master Mix (Bio‑Techne).

steps.title: Heat samples for detection
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 95 °C for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Load onto JESS microplate
steps.instruction: Load the heated mixture into a JESS microplate (Bio‑Techne) for analysis on the Automated Western Blot system.
